title: Slightly Optimized
description: A simple modpacks to slightly enhance your performance
body:
Slightly Optimized


Information

A simple modpacks to slightly increase your performance when playing Minecraft. This modpacks contains less mods than other modpacks, in order to increase the performance without needing too many mods

Mods Included 1. [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) 2. [Concurrent Chunk Management](https://modrinth.com/mod/c2me-fabric) 3. [Entity Culling](https://modrinth.com/mod/entityculling) 4. [Entity Model Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) 5. [Entity Texture Features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-texture-features) 4. [Ferrite Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/ferrite-core) 5. [Immediately Fast](https://modrinth.com/mod/immediatelyfast) 6. [Iris Shaders](https://modrinth.com/mod/iris) 7. [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium) 8. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) 9. [Not Enough Animations](https://modrinth.com/mod/not-enough-animations) 10. [Reese's Sodium Options](https://modrinth.com/mod/reeses-sodium-options) 11. [Smooth Scrolling](https://modrinth.com/mod/smooth-scroll) 12. [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) 13. [Sodium Extra](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium-extra) 14. [Zoomify](https://modrinth.com/mod/zoomify)
Mods dependencies (included) 1. [Fabric Api](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) 2. [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin) 3. [Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) 3. [Yet Another Config Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
